vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SonicWall SMA1000 Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SonicWall SMA1000 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to perform unauthorized operations.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.
